name: @pipeworx/mcp-zenodo

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Zenodo open-research repository for datasets, publications, software, and other research outputs by keyword query. Filterable by type, community, and sort order (mostrecent/bestmatch/mostviewed); returns metadata, DOI, and file links.

type.description: dataset | publication | software | presentation | poster | image | video | other

tools.name: record_files
tools.description: List files attached to a Zenodo record by its numeric id. Returns file names, sizes, checksums, and direct download URLs.

tools.name: communities
tools.description: List or search Zenodo communities (thematic collections of records) by optional keyword query; returns community id, title, description, and record count.

tools.name: community_records
tools.description: Fetch paginated records belonging to a Zenodo community by its slug id (e.g. "openaire"). Returns record metadata, DOIs, and file links for all items in the community.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-zenodo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the zenodo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
